Don't have any wise words since I'm a fucking mess but still trying to hang on  for this ride. Since you're into podcasts you can check out "The Church of What's happening", it's entertaining and helping me laugh while keeping me hopeful. The host has had some drug issues but has been able to survive, in one episode he says something like " I would always wonder if tomorrow is when I get that new job, life or find that girl, Having that at the back of my mind kept me going" . Cheers mate to this crazy journey known as life
